purpose: Evaluate whether information channels improve out-of-sample estimates beyond simple existing price/volatility baselines. No automatic promotion into scoring, gates, or execution.
outcome_status: Preregistered before inspecting outcome statistics. Preserve all failed and insufficient trials.
limitations: Named present-day liquid universe is survivorship-selected; results apply only to this conditional universe.
Historical prices and public index histories are end-of-day observations; entry is the NEXT session close, never the signal day's earlier close.
News and analyst events are available only after archived_at / first_seen; revised publication/grade dates never establish availability.
Underlying return or volatility predictability is not evidence that an option strategy makes money. Actual option quote paths and costs require a separate study.
No search for optimal thresholds, symbols, feature signs, or holding horizons after results. These eight trials are the declared search family.
Macro data needing historical release vintages is deferred until point-in-time series are available. Current revised economic history is not a valid substitute.

evaluation.multiple_testing: Holm across all eight preregistered trials, including insufficient trials as p=1.
evaluation.primary_statistic: Mean date-level reduction in squared prediction error, candidate minus baseline improvement; positive favors the added channel. Moving-block bootstrap over four consecutive non-overlapping evaluation dates, retaining all names within a date; this also preserves short-range serial dependence.
evaluation.secondary_statistics: Baseline/candidate RMSE, percent MSE improvement, directional hit rates only for return targets, per-year mean error improvement, evaluation observation counts.
evaluation.purge: Every training label must end strictly before the first feature date of its test block. Standardization and fit use training data only.
evaluation.independence: Test dates sampled at horizon+2 trading sessions to avoid overlapping holding intervals, including next-session entry. One cluster per evaluation date across all names.
evaluation.verdict: INSUFFICIENT if min train dates, min held-out dates or years fails; RESEARCH_SUPPORT only if family-adjusted p<0.05, bootstrap CI lower bound>0, and a majority of test years improve; otherwise NOT_ESTABLISHED. No verdict authorises capital.

trials.question: Do VIX level and trend improve next-week realized-risk estimates beyond trailing realized risk?
Does the same information improve next-month realized-risk estimates?
Does VIX add directional information after controlling for price momentum and trailing risk?
Does leave-one-out peer momentum improve a stock's future excess-return estimate beyond its own momentum and the market?
Does first-seen headline tone add directional information beyond prices?
Does unusual first-seen news volume add risk information beyond trailing realized risk?
Does disagreement among contemporaneously observed headlines add risk information?
Do upgrades minus downgrades, observed at first_seen rather than backfilled grade_date, improve directional estimates?
